property_summary: After calling c.deny(user) then c.rely(user) as an unprivileged user, the reference contract's deny sets wards[user]=0 so rely reverts, while the buggy contract leaves wards[user]=1 so rely succeeds, causing the result of c.wards(user) to differ.
change_summary: Replace the assignment in deny() with a no-op (assign to a local variable instead of state).
